title: Trails
description: Trails in Sandy City, Utah area. 1,127 multilinestring features, mirrored as GeoParquet in EPSG:3566 (NAD83(HARN) / Utah Central (ftUS)) with Web Mercator vector tiles for display. See the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) for the schema, the coded-value lists and queries that run.

links.title: Sandy City, Utah — Municipal Open Data
Sandy City GIS, the publisher of this layer
Licence status: Sandy City states no licence

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: Esri object identifier. A row number assigned by the source geodatabase and reassigned when the layer is republished. It is not a stable key and must not be used to join across collections or across refreshes.

table:columns.name: Name
table:columns.description: Name of the feature. Measured in the published file: Populated on 93% of 1,127 rows, 182 distinct values.

table:columns.name: USAGE_
table:columns.description: Permitted use summary for the segment.

table:columns.name: TrailID
table:columns.description: Identifier of the trail segment.

table:columns.name: SystemName
table:columns.description: Name of the trail system the segment belongs to.

table:columns.name: SharedName
table:columns.description: Alternative name the segment is also known by.

table:columns.name: SystemType
table:columns.description: Type of trail system.

table:columns.name: ParkID
table:columns.description: Identifier of the park the feature belongs to, joining to the parks collection. Measured in the published file: Populated on 38% of 1,127 rows, 48 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Park_ID
table:columns.description: Numeric identifier of the park the feature belongs to. Measured in the published file: Populated on 38% of 1,127 rows, 48 distinct values, ranging 2 to 70.

table:columns.name: CityMuni
table:columns.description: Municipality the segment runs through. The layer extends beyond Sandy, so filter on this for Sandy's own trails: 788 of 1,127 segments.

table:columns.name: County
table:columns.description: County the feature falls in. Sandy is in Salt Lake County. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 1,127 rows, 2 distinct values.

table:columns.name: State
table:columns.description: State the feature falls in. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 1,127 rows, 1 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Status
table:columns.description: Whether the segment is open, planned or proposed. Only the 920 open segments exist on the ground.

table:columns.name: YearOpen
table:columns.description: Year the segment opened.

table:columns.name: Trails_JAKE_Temp_Length
table:columns.description: Length. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 1,127 rows, 1,109 distinct values, ranging 4.96972 to 40097.9.

table:columns.name: L_Units
table:columns.description: Unit the length value is in.

table:columns.name: L_Source
table:columns.description: Where the length measurement came from.

table:columns.name: TrlSurface
table:columns.description: Tread surface of the trail, such as hard surface or native material.

table:columns.name: Width
table:columns.description: Trail width, in the units given by `W_Units`.

table:columns.name: W_Units
table:columns.description: Unit the `Width` value is in.

table:columns.name: Rating
table:columns.description: Difficulty rating of the segment.

table:columns.name: DesignUse
table:columns.description: Use the trail was designed and is managed for, which is narrower than the set of uses it permits.

table:columns.name: UseComment
table:columns.description: Note qualifying the permitted uses.

table:columns.name: Accessible
table:columns.description: Accessibility status of the segment.

table:columns.name: Motorized
table:columns.description: Whether motorised use is permitted.

table:columns.name: Hike
table:columns.description: Whether hiking is permitted.

table:columns.name: RoadBike
table:columns.description: Whether road cycling is permitted.

table:columns.name: MtnBike
table:columns.description: Whether mountain biking is permitted.

table:columns.name: Equestrian
table:columns.description: Whether horse riding is permitted.

table:columns.name: DogSled
table:columns.description: Whether dog sledding is permitted.

table:columns.name: Snowmobile
table:columns.description: Whether snowmobiles are permitted.

table:columns.name: Snowshoe
table:columns.description: Whether snowshoeing is permitted.

table:columns.name: XCntrySki
table:columns.description: Whether cross-country skiing is permitted.

table:columns.name: WCraft_Mtr
table:columns.description: Whether motorised watercraft are permitted, for a water trail.

table:columns.name: WCraft_Non
table:columns.description: Whether non-motorised watercraft are permitted.

table:columns.name: Portage
table:columns.description: Whether the segment is a portage between waterways.

table:columns.name: ATV
table:columns.description: Whether all-terrain vehicles are permitted.

table:columns.name: FourWD
table:columns.description: Whether four-wheel-drive vehicles are permitted.

table:columns.name: Motorcycle
table:columns.description: Whether motorcycles are permitted.

table:columns.name: ParkTrail
table:columns.description: Whether the segment lies within a park.

table:columns.name: OnStreetBike
table:columns.description: Whether the segment is an on-street bicycle route.

table:columns.name: AgencyName
table:columns.description: Organisation that manages the segment.

table:columns.name: AgencyType
table:columns.description: Type of managing organisation, such as municipal or special district.

table:columns.name: AcqSource
table:columns.description: Funding source the land was acquired with.

table:columns.name: AcqMethod
table:columns.description: How the land was acquired, such as fee simple or easement.

table:columns.name: AcqComment
table:columns.description: Note on the acquisition.

table:columns.name: LWCFProt
table:columns.description: Whether the segment is protected by the Land and Water Conservation Fund, which restricts converting the land to another use.

table:columns.name: OtherProt
table:columns.description: Other protection that applies to the land.

table:columns.name: ResPrtCmnt
table:columns.description: Note on restrictions or protections.

table:columns.name: EditDate
table:columns.description: Timestamp when the row was last edited, from the geodatabase editor tracking. It records the database edit, not a change in the world.

table:columns.name: AssetID
table:columns.description: Identifier of the asset in the city's maintenance management system. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 1,127 rows, 1,089 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Address
table:columns.description: Street address of the feature. Measured in the published file: Populated on 70% of 1,127 rows, 137 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Location
table:columns.description: Street address or place description of the feature. Measured in the published file: Populated on 70% of 1,127 rows, 137 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Shape_Length_1
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 0% of 1,127 rows, 2 distinct values, ranging 3951.35 to 10059.5.

table:columns.name: Shape
table:columns.description: Residual Esri geometry field. It carries no coordinates here; the geometry is in the `geometry` column.

table:columns.name: Shape.STLength()
table:columns.description: Line length or polygon perimeter computed by the geodatabase, in the units of the source coordinate system. Recompute it from the geometry rather than trusting it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, WKB encoded, in the collection's `proj:epsg` coordinate system.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box written by gpio, as a struct of `xmin`, `ymin`, `xmax`, `ymax`, in the same coordinate system as the geometry. Rows are in Hilbert order, so filtering on this column prunes row groups efficiently.
